description: Extract content from a web page. Returns structured data based on the extraction type. Supports: markdown (readable content), text (plain text), html (raw HTML), article (structured with title/author/excerpt), links (all page links), metadata (OG tags, title, description).

cache.description: Use cached result if available (default: false)

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load (default: 0)

selector.description: CSS selector to scope extraction to a specific element

url.description: URL to extract content from (must start with http:// or https://)

name: extract_content
